description: Reg. § 1.36B-2(b)(6): household income below 100% of the poverty line still qualifies when the Marketplace estimated at enrollment that it would be at least 100% and advance PTC was paid. Single 2025: wages $50,000, nonpassive Schedule E loss $160,000 → household income −$110,000, entered as $0 (Form 8962 line 3). Applicable percentage 0% (first tier) → credit = min($8,000 premiums, $8,000 benchmark − $0) = $8,000; advance PTC $6,000 → net PTC $2,000 refund, nothing repaid.
